count_readout.title: How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?
count_readout.adaptation: Mean/max/scaled-sum layer readouts plus explicit log node count. Motivated by multiset/count expressiveness; not a GIN reproduction or expressivity proof.

language_heads.title: Deep Canonical Correlation Analysis
language_heads.adaptation: Shared GNN backbone with separate paired-view COBOL/Java projections, trained with InfoNCE. Paired-view motivation, not the DCCA objective.

structural_cca.title: Weisfeiler-Lehman Graph Kernels
structural_cca.adaptation: Fixed hashed relation-aware WL counts and semantic statistics; fold-local standardization and regularized linear CCA (ridge0.1,24outputs), not DCCA.

graph_regularized.title: Graph Contrastive Learning with Augmentations
graph_regularized.adaptation: 10% auxiliary sequence-edge dropout during fitting, preserving paired directions and all data/control edges and numeric features. GraphCL-inspired regularization, not a full GraphCL reproduction.

configuration.selection: Checkpoint: pooled120 OOF Top1, then MRR, then lower validation loss, then earliest epoch. Candidate: pooled OOF Top1, then MRR, then fixed declared simplicity order.

neuralTraining.initialization: fresh parameters and Adam state for every96-pair fold

structuralCca.preprocessing: means/scales and CCA fitted exclusively on each96-pair fitting fold

calibration.reason: Benchmark-only retrieval evidence; financial-domain reliability remains unvalidated. Every ranking requires explicit human review.
calibration.method: Fixed before CV and final evaluation; no holdout threshold selection.

configuration.finalProtocol: Freeze all5candidate ensembles and CVwinner before final learned encoding; evaluate all on same23once; deploy CVwinner regardless final ranking.
configuration.partitionPolicyOverride: Reuse v2/v3 graph components and exact120/23/foldassignments. Supersede historical full-development refit policy: neverfit120.

limitations: 143 small HumanEval-derived paired tasks, not production banking migrations or defect labels.

All23 final tasks were evaluated in v1/v2/v3. This new protocol was requested after earlier results were visible; final results are descriptive on a reused benchmark, not pristine unseen-data evidence.
Every learned transformation and preprocessing statistic uses only its96 fitting pairs. No120-pair full-development fit or refit.
CV evaluates each query by its one designated held-out member, not by the other four members that trained on it; CV is a selection statistic, not nested unbiased ensemble validation.
Names, comments, task IDs and method/program names are excluded from learned features. Structural graphs are heuristic, not compiler semantics.
Graph dropout is regularization on views of original fitting pairs, not additional authentic source pairs or a behavior-preserving code transformation.
Paper results motivate these adaptations; they do not guarantee gains on COBOL-JavaTrans.
Matching cosine is not a correctness probability or equivalence proof. Every result requires review; Z3 is independent.
All final candidates are reported, but deployment follows the frozen CV winner even if another final score is higher. No final-driven tuning, member choice or model switch.
